title: Pure Valkyrie
summary: Pure Valkyrie battle-phase swarm and turn-skip strategy, deploying Zigfried von Schroeder's legendary LIGHT Fairy maidens to overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. The deck swarms the field with Ride of the Valkyries and uses Mischief of the Time Goddess to leap directly to your next turn's Battle Phase for an unanswerable assault.

summary.title: Starters
points: Valkyrie Dritte searches any Valkyrie card from your Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, and gains 200 ATK for each of the opponent's banished monsters.
Ride of the Valkyries Special Summons any number of Valkyrie monsters with different names from your hand, shuffling them into the Deck during the End Phase unless you skip it.
Valkyrie Sechste Special Summons any Valkyrie monster directly from your Deck whenever it is Special Summoned.
Valkyrie Sigrun sends a face-up Spell or Trap you control to the GY to Special Summon itself from your hand, then revives a Level 8 or lower Valkyrie monster from hand or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Ride + Mischief OTK
steps: Normal Summon Valkyrie Dritte to search Ride of the Valkyries from your Deck.
Activate Ride of the Valkyries, Special Summoning Valkyrie Sechste, Valkyrie Erste, and Valkyrie Brunhilde from your hand.
Valkyrie Sechste triggers on Special Summon to Special Summon Valkyrie Zweite directly from your Deck, which destroys 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
Enter your Battle Phase and declare attacks with all of your Valkyrie monsters.

At the end of your Battle Phase, activate Mischief of the Time Goddess while controlling only Valkyrie monsters, skipping directly to the Battle Phase of your next turn and bypassing Ride of the Valkyries' shuffle drawback.

summary.title: The Three Goddesses of Fate
points: Goddess Skuld's Oracle reorganizes the top 3 cards of the opponent's Deck in any order and searches Goddess Verdande's Guidance.
Goddess Verdande's Guidance declares a card type to look at the opponent's top card, setting it face-down to your opponent's field if correct and searching Goddess Urd's Verdict.
Goddess Urd's Verdict shields all Valkyrie monsters from targeting and destruction by opponent card effects, and names a card to banish an opponent's Set card face-down if guessed correctly.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Valkyrie Brunhilde is completely unaffected by the opponent's Spell effects and gains 1000 ATK for each monster the opponent controls.
Valkyrie Erda reduces the ATK of all opponent monsters by 1000 while summoned by a Valkyrie effect, and banishes any card the opponent controls that is destroyed.
Valkyrie Erste banishes a monster from the opponent's GY and adds Mischief of the Time Goddess from your GY back to your hand when Special Summoned by a Spell.
Valkyrie Zweite targets and destroys an opponent's monster upon summon and recovers a Continuous Spell from your GY.
Final Light pays Life Points in multiples of 1000 to revive that many Valkyrie monsters with different names from your GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Element Valkyrie and Valkyrie of the Nordic Ascendant are omitted because they share only the name and lack synergy with Zigfried's dedicated Fairy mechanics.
